Breakfast Fruit Smoothie
By: Renat Zarbailov
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:18pm

Ingredients




1 cup cold cranberry juice
2 tablespoons of  dry oatmeal
1 Banana

Preparation

1 POUR ONE CUP OF COLD CRANBERRY JUICE INTO BLENDER 2 ADD TWO TABLE SPOONS OF DRY OATMEAL ON TOP 3 DROP A BANANA 4 BLEND (if you find it too sweet ad some water and blend again)

About


I was experimenting to achieve different cocktail tastes, and this is what I found to be a successful one.
Enjoy!
